cases.description: A rewrite rule: lhs \Rightarrow rhs, its params and priority in a rule container (Typst #rule).
cases.markdown:
---
esm: "2.4.0"
name: "fixture"
---

::model[M]

:var[$c$]{default=0 units="kg/m^3"}

:param[$u$]{default=1 units="m/s"}

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d} c}{\mathrm{d} t} = -u c
$$

:::rule{params='["f"]' priority=1}
$$
\text{rule } \operatorname{upwind}: \; \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \Rightarrow \nabla f
$$
:::
